tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i rim pa 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa de la sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bla ma rin po che/ /slu ba med pa'i skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum/ /dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam srung ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so myur mgyogs thugs rjes gzung / /skyabs mchog sgrib med ye shes spyan ldan rnams/ /mos gus drag po'i stobs kyis spyan 'dren na/ /gzugs sku brtse ba chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /dad ldan mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhing rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i lus sprul nas/ /yon tan brjod pa'i ngag gis bstod byed cing / /lhag bsam rnam dag gus pa'i yid kyis ni/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /gang gi mtshan tsam yid la dran pas kyang / /bdag blo'i rgud pa ma lus sel mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan sogs༞/dri med yon tan gzi 'od rab tu 'phro/ /'gro ba kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /dpal ldan༞/blang dor 'byed pa'i blo gros 'od stong gis/ /'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa rab bsal nas/ /legs lam gsal ba'i nyi ma chos kyi rje/ /dpal ldan༞/dam chos nying khu bdud rtsi sman mchog gis/ /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal nad sel ba'i/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sman pa mchog /dpal ldan༞/phul byung thabs dang shes rab gru chen gyis/ /rang gzhan srid zhi'i rgya mtsho'i mtha' sgrol ba'i/ /stobs ldan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon mchog /dpal ldan༞/nyes pa'i skyon rnams ma lus rab spangs shing / /legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rab tu ldan/

/dpal 'byor phun tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /dpal ldan༞/mtshan dpe gsal la rdzogs pa rgyal ba'i sku/ /zab yangs dam chos sgrog pa rgyal ba'i gsung / /mkhyen brtse 'od stong gsal ba rgyal ba'i thugs/ /dpal ldan༞/dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /legs gsung dam chos rin chen kun gyi gter/ /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dge 'dun kun gyi rje/ /dpal ldan༞/dbang rgyud man ngag kun la dbang 'byor zhing / /bdag pas gzhan gces 'byongs pa'i byang chub sems/ /rnam mang mkhas btsun 'dus pa kun gyi gtso/ /dpal ldan༞/spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi sku/ /theg chen chos la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /gdul bya'i re 'dod skong ba sprul pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan༞/phung po rnam lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / /'byung ba rnam lnga yum lnga'i rang bzhin can/ /thams cad 'dus pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan༞/phyi nang skye mched sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs/ /yan lag rnams ni khro bo khro mo'i sku/ /khams dang rtsa ni dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs/ /dpal ldan༞/nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa rlung dbang 'dus pas/ /snod dang bcud kyi zhing khams ma lus pa/ /dag pa lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin can/ /dpal ldan༞/khyod sku dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor dang / /khyod gsung dag pa gsang sngags rdo rje'i tshig /khyod thugs dag pa bde chen chos kyi sku/ /dpal ldan༞/mtha' yas 'gro ba smin cing grol bya'i phyir/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas ma lus pa/ /'dren pa'i tshul gyis rnam par 'phrul pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan༞/dkon mchog mchod dang sems can don sgrub phyir/ /bsod nams longs spyod bcas pa bdag gi lus/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bran du legs phul nas/ /ji ltar bzhed pa'i don kun 'grub par shog/ ༈ //mkha' khyab mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med sprul/ /mkha' khyab phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgyas par na mchod sprin gyi gnas dang /

mchod rdzas kyi gnas su mchod yon sogs nas rol mo'i bar sbyar ba phyag len yin/ kun/ /mkha' khyab dpal ldan bla ma dgyes phyir 'bul/ /mkha' khyab skye dgu'i re 'dod skong bar shog /bkod legs blta na sdug pa mchod pa'i sprin/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod rdzas rnams/ /dpal ldan bla ma dgyes phyir gus pas 'bul/ /'gro kun dbul ba sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor 'byung ba'i gnas/ /lha rdzas rin chen rgyas par byed na rin chen gyi gnas su 'khor lo sogs rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba phyag len yin/ ji snyed yod pa kun/ /dpal ldan bla ma dgyes phyir gus pas 'bul/ /'gro kun phan bde rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin du/ /rmad byung 'dod pa'i rgyas par na 'dod pa'i gnas su gzugs kyi yon tan nas reg bya'i bar sbyar ba phyag len/ yon tan dpag med rnams/ /dpal ldan bla ma dgyes phyir gus pas 'bul/ /'gro kun chos 'byor rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// ༈ //dpal 'byor phun tshogs dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /'khor tshogs yon tan phrin las dpag med kyi/ /sangs rgyas byang sems du mas gang ba yi/ /phun tshogs dag pa'i zhing gis bla ma mchod/ /rab yangs 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor brtan pa la/ /bkod legs ri gling 'khor yug rgya mtshos spras/ /brtan g.yo'i dpal gyis phyur bur gtams pa yi/ /phun tshogs 'jig rten khams kyis bla ma mchod/ /nyi zla rgyu skar rgyas pa dwangs pa'i mkha'/ /'ja' tshon na bun sprin gyis mdzes gyur zhing / /nor bu'i mdangs 'phrog kun gyi go 'byed pa'i/ /phun tshogs nam mkha'i khams kyis༞/'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen ri bo dang / /rtsi sman rgyas pa'i nags dang gangs ri sogs/ /dbyibs legs lhun sdug skye bos brten gyur pa/ /phun tshogs ri bo kun gyis༞/yid 'ong me tog 'bras bu rab rgyas pa'i/

/yangs pa'i spangs shongs nags tshal la sogs pa/ /bde zhing nyams dga'i dpal 'byor gyis gang ba'i/ /phun tshogs bsti gnas kun gyis༞/rgyal ba'i mchod sdong ma smos lo tog dang / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rdzing bu sogs/ /phun tshogs longs spyod kun gyis༞dri med bai ḍūr sa gzhi yangs pa la/ /gser dngul rtsig pa ba gam drwa ba can/ /rin chen ka bas bteg cing khyon yangs pa'i/ /phun tshogs gzhal med khang gis bla ma mchod/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan gdugs kyis steng nas mdzes/ /dar dpyangs lhab lhub g.yo bas logs nas brgyan/ /rin chen gdan khri mthon pos 'og nas brjid/ /phun tshogs nye mkho'i dpal gyis༞/thar pa'i rgyal mtshan chos gos ngur smrig dang / /pañtsa li ka lha yi gos bzang dang / /rab mdzes srab 'jam yang ba'i dar la sogs/ /phun tshogs na bza' kun gyis༞/rin chen dbu rgyan dar gyi cod pan dang / /mu tig do shal nor bu'i ga shal dang / /rin chen phra bkod gser gyi gdu bu sogs/ /phun tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis༞/phun tshogs nor gyi gter chen bum pa dang / /a kar la sogs sman mchog mtha' yas dang / /'bras sogs bcud ldan 'bru yi phung po sogs/ /phun tshogs ro brgya'i zas kyis༞/phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams dpag med na/ /snod kyi dpal 'byor mchod 'os ji snyed kun/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /yid kyis legs par sprul nas bla ma mchod// ༈ /khams gsum dbang phyug tshangs pa brgya byin dang / /sa skyong 'khor los sgyur rgyal klu dbang sogs/ /btsun mo sras dang mnga' thang rab rgyas pa'i/ /phun tshogs skye dgu'i dbang pos༞/rigs gzugs 'byor ldan blon po khyim bdag dang / /nyams dga' glu len khye'u pho mo'i tshogs/ /gzugs mdzes skad snyan yid gzhung gos rgyan can/ /phun tshogs khye'u kun gyis༞/ri ngos 'gying ba'i seng ge khyu mchog dang /

/ri sul rgyu ba'i kṛṣṇa sa ra sogs/ 'khrul rgyas mdangs bkrag nges pa'i goms stabs can/ /phun tshogs ri dwags kun gyis༞/nags rir snyan sgrog ri skeg khu byug dang / /sa gzhi'i rgyan gyur bzhad dang khrung khrung sogs/ /skad snyan spu sdug mdzes pa'i gar stabs can/ /phun tshogs 'dab chags kun gyis༞/mdor na snod kyi sa phyogs yid 'ong na/ /bcud kyi sems can mchod 'os ji snyed pa/ /bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung de dag kun/ /blo yis legs par blangs nas bla ma mchod// ༈ //bsod nams du ma'i dpal las 'khrungs pa'i rdzas/ /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang / /glang po rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen te/ /rgyal srid sna bdun dag gis༞/nye bar mkho ba'i 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /tshal dang khang bzang mal stan ral gri dang / /rin chen lpags pa lh+wam dang lha yi gos/ /nye ba'i sna bdun kun gyis༞/bkra shis rdzas su legs par byin brlabs pa'i/ /me long gi wang ba zho dur ba dang / /yungs kar bil ba li khri dung dkar te/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad kun gyis༞/skye dgu bde zhing dge bar byed pa'i rdzas/ /dpal be'u 'khor lo padma rgyal mtshan dang / /gdugs dang bum pa dung dkar gser nya ste/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad kun gyis bla ma mchod// ༈ //zag med bde bas myos byed ma da na/ /stobs ldan go ku la sogs ba la dang / /bcud ldan bi mu shu sogs 'chi med de/ /nang gi dam rdzas kun gyis༞/phyag rgya bzhi dang snyoms par sbyor ba la/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde ba che/ /zag med lus sems ltas par byed pa'i mchog /gsang chen dga' bzhi'i dpal gyis༞/bde gshegs snying po'i sa gzhi ltar ba la/ /dri med byang chub sems kyi yon chab gtams/ /dkar po dge bcu'i me tog bsil ma bkram/ /rnam dag khrims kyi bdug pas༞/spyan dang mngon shes gsal ba'i sgron me dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'i dri mchog kun nas 'khyil/

/snyoms 'jug dgu yi zhal zas rmad du byung / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rol mos༞/zab cing rgya che'i sgra ldan chos kyi dung / /legs gsung dam chos ston pa'i rnga bo che/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa spel ba'i gaṇḍe'i sgra/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rol mos༞/dri med ngad pa'i sa gzhi yangs pa la/ /byang phyogs so bdun ri gling rab tu mdzes/ /shes rab snying rje'i nyi zla cher gsal ba'i/ /tshogs gnyis 'khor yug chen pos༞/sa bcu'i yon tan dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i ba/ /pha rol phyin bcu dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /chos spyod rnam bcu'i ma rmos lo tog rgyas/ /dbang bcu'i gter chen bum pas༞/bsdu dngos gzungs dang spobs pa'i rgyan phreng can/ /zag med phung po 'dod yon rnam lnga bkram/ /byang chub yan lag rgyal srid sna bdun bkod/ /bkra shis rnam thar brgyad kyis༞/stobs bcu'i rgyal mtshan sku bzhi'i tog gis mdzes/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yi gdugs dkar rmad du byung / /ma 'dres bco brgyad snyan pa'i ba dan 'phyar/ /zil gnon rnga yab g.yo bas༞/grub chen brgyad kyi mtshan gyis rab tu brjid/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi dpe byad shin tu mdzes/ /las tshogs rab 'byams srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /dngos grub 'khor los bsgyur bas༞/smin grol zab mo'i dpal gyis rab brjid cing / /dga' ba bcu drug dpa' bo'i gar stabs can/ /bde stong sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul dang ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid bcu drug dpa' mos༞/'khor 'das dbye ba med pa'i lta ba dang / /bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i sgom pa dang / /srid zhi mnyam nyid 'byongs pa'i spyod pa ste/ /don gnyis mthar phyin 'bras bus༞/mdor na theg pa gsum dang gsang sngags kyi/ /spangs rtogs yon tan ji snyed yod pa kun/ /dad 'dun blo yis blangs shing sprul byas nas/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa dam pas༞/mtha' bzhi spros pa kun dang bral ba yi/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin la/

/zab zhi spros dang bral ba gnyug ma'i ngang / /'od gsal phyag rgya chen pos༞/bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge ba sogs/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /mi rigs nyes pa gang bgyis so sor bshags/ /rab dkar dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' yun du bzhugs par gsol/ /'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i rab dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /srid gsum 'khor ba'i 'ching ba las grol te/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas/ /kun mkhyen mchog gi dngos grub myur thob shog /'gro kun bla med byang chub thob don du/ /skyabs mchog khyed la rtag par skyabs mchi zhing / /thun mong khyad par dam tshig sdom pa rnams/ /deng nas bzung ste tshul bzhin sgrub par bgyi/ /yid la 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /skyabs mchog khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rin po che/ /thos bsam bsgom pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /thar pa'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen rnams/ /sku la bsnyun med phrin las rab rgyas nas/ /rtag tu gdul byar gyur ba'i 'gro ba kun/ /thar pa'i bde la myur du 'god par shog /dam chos sgrub la brtson pa thams cad kyis/ /lam zab bla ma'i mos gus mthar phyin te/ /lus dang longs spyod dge bas mnyes byas nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /skyabs mchog khyed kyis 'gro ba'i don rab mdzad/ /chos kyi sku la 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' yang / /gzugs sku bdag gi lus la rab bkod nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /khyed sku bdag gi lus dang gcig tu gyur/ /khyed gsung bdag gi ngag la rjes su zhugs/ /khyed thugs bdag gi sems dang 'dres gyur nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/

/sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kun/ /bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum bya ba la/ /brtan par bzhugs nas gnas skabs thams cad du/ /'dod dgu'i byin rlabs char bzhin 'bab par shog /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor snying po longs pa dang / /bsams pa'i don la bar chad med pa dang / /gnas skabs kun tu phan bde rgyas pa yi/ /tshe dang chos 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bshad sgrub bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /byas pa'i las rnams gzhan don 'gyur ba dang / /spyod pa kun la sangs rgyas dgyes pa yi/ /ci bsams chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bla ma dam pa la mchod pa'i rim pa paṇḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pas dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar pa'o// //oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan rgyal ba byamaṃs pa'iṃ ngo bo/ /'gro la chosaṃ kyiṃ dga' ston sbyin mdzad/ /doṃn gnyis lhun grubaṃ 'bumaṃ phragaṃ gsumaṃ la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i gtsug gis mchod do/ /'dren pa nyid dang nyid kyi bstan pa/ /skyabs mchog rin chen dbang gi rgyal po/ /rnyed bkur rgyal mtshan rtse mor legs mchod/ /'gro la 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor rab stsol/ /mi dbang bsod nams brgya phrag dag las/ /legs par bskrun pa'i dal 'byor rten bzang / /dpal 'byor phun tshogs ma lus 'dzom pas/ /chos sgo bar gyi dga' ston legs stsal/ /mkha' khyab 'gro la phan bde'i dge legs/ /ma lus 'byung ba nyid du gyur cig /par la mkhas pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i rim pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
